query:
UPDATE posthog_person
                SET is_deleted = false,
                    version = GREATEST(
                        COALESCE(version, 0) + CASE WHEN is_deleted THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
                        $3
                    )
                WHERE team_id = $1 AND uuid = ANY($2)
                RETURNING uuid as "uuid!", version as "version!"
